verdict.rationale: The firm's own late-stage company and D&O questionnaire pages document dedicated M&A and IPO-preparation expertise ('deep expertise helping private companies achieve the best possible M&A outcomes', 'Preparations for an IPO typically get underway two years in advance'), backed by concrete deal credentials ($100B+ financings since 2020, Anthropic Series H, Hugging Face/NVIDIA sale) and a purpose-built public-company tool (D&O Questionnaire Portal). This spans the founder journey from venture financing through exit on dedicated firm pages. Missing for 10: independent/third-party corroboration of IPO track record (e.g., league tables specifically for IPOs) and more granular detail on post-IPO public company counsel beyond the D&O portal.
